headlines.title: Reform UK’s Farage failed to disclose funds from convicted criminal: Report
headlines.snippet: Reportedly, George Cottrell provided funds for the security, drivers, staff, and accommodation of the Reform UK leader. This was detailed in a report by the Sunday Times.

headlines.snippet_he: לפי הדיווחים, ג'ורג' קוטרל סיפק מימון לאבטחה, נהגים, צוות ומגורים של מנהיג הרפורמה בריטניה. דבר זה פורסם בדיווח של הסאנדיי טיימס.

headlines.title: How xenophobia went viral in South Africa

headlines.title: China releases underground church pastor after months in detention
headlines.snippet: The founder of Zion Church, Ezra Jin, has reportedly arrived in the US after being detained in China for several months. His family confirmed his release.
headlines.title_he: סין משחררת כומר כנסייה מחתרתית לאחר חודשים במעצר

headlines.snippet: Iran's ambassador to China has stated that friendly countries will receive special treatment in the Strait of Hormuz. This comes despite objections from the US regarding new transit fees.

headlines.snippet_he: שגריר איראן בסין הצהיר כי מדינות ידידותיות יקבלו יחס מיוחד במצר הורמוז. זה קורה למרות התנגדויות מארה"ב בנוגע לדמי תחבורה חדשים.

headlines.title: Trump offers to help end Russia-Ukraine war in Putin call, Kremlin says
headlines.snippet: According to the Kremlin, Donald Trump offered to help end the war between Russia and Ukraine during a phone call with the Russian president.

headlines.title: Cargo vessel attacked near Yemen's Hodeidah, UK maritime agency says

headlines.title: Slain Ayatollah’s son attends funeral as current Ayatollah stays away
headlines.snippet: Three sons of the slain Iranian leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei prayed at his funeral, alongside four other family members. However, Mojtaba, who has succeeded him, was not present.
headlines.title_he: בנו של האייתוללה שנרצח משתתף בהלוויה בעוד האייתולה הנוכחי נשאר רחוק

headlines.title: Araghchi meets Hamas and Hezbollah delegations in Tehran
headlines.snippet: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi met with delegations from Hamas and Hezbollah in Tehran. The meetings were held during funeral ceremonies for former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, and discussions included conditions in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

headlines.title: Turkey eyes US green light for fighter jet engines at NATO summit
headlines.snippet: Analysts suggest that President Donald Trump's visit to Ankara for the NATO summit might facilitate Turkey's acquisition of fighter jet engines. However, the F-35 dispute, which has strained relations, is unlikely to be resolved.
headlines.title_he: טורקיה מבקשת אור ירוק אמריקאי למנועי מטוסי קרב בפסגת נאט"ו

headlines.title: Iraqi cities of Najaf and Karbala to receive Khamenei’s remains
headlines.snippet: Following ceremonies in Tehran and Qom, the remains of former Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei are scheduled to be taken to Iraq for services in Najaf and Karbala. His body will then be returned to Iran for burial.
